# TabVault: Tab Session Saver

> A Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that saves HTTP/HTTPS tabs in a window as a named
> session and restores their URLs, order and pinned state later.

- Website: https://wd9337812.github.io/tabvault/
- Source / issues: https://github.com/wd9337812/tabvault
- Category: Productivity / browser tab management
- Price: free (5 manual sessions), Pro is a one-time $6 lifetime license
- Chrome Web Store: coming soon (pending review)
- Privacy: task/session storage is local in `chrome.storage`; no developer content server, no account, no analytics,
  no cookies; zero `host_permissions`; uses `tabs` for saving, the tab-count badge and optional backup/recovery.
- Features: save a window and close extra tabs (retains the first tab), restore into a new or the current window,
  recovery banner from available snapshots, 15-minute automatic backup of normal windows (Pro),
  cross-session search (Pro), export to JSON / Markdown / CSV / clipboard (Pro),
  paste-a-bunch-of-URLs to open or save as a session, built-in English / Chinese UI.
- Support: https://wd9337812.github.io/tabvault/SUPPORT.html
- Privacy policy: https://wd9337812.github.io/tabvault/PRIVACY.html

With Pro auto-backup enabled, normal-window tab changes maintain a local recovery cache. Up to 20 automatic snapshots are retained in total; manual sessions are never age-pruned. Recovery uses available snapshots and cannot guarantee unsaved changes.
